name: Figma
description: My primary design tool. I use it to wireframe, prototype, and produce developer-ready designs — and to collaborate with designers to ensure what gets built matches the intent.

name: Next.js
description: My main framework for production web applications. I use it for its file-based routing, server-side rendering, and performance optimisations — it's the backbone of most things I ship.

name: React.js
description: The foundation of how I think about UI. I use React to build reusable, composable component systems that scale cleanly across projects of any size.

name: Supabase
description: My go-to for backend infrastructure on full-stack projects. I use it for database management, authentication, and file storage — most recently as the core backend for IIMO.

name: Node.js
description: Used for building server-side logic and APIs. Gives me the ability to work across the full stack and understand the backend context that my frontend interfaces consume.

name: Vercel
description: My default deployment platform for Next.js projects. I use it for its seamless CI/CD pipeline, preview deployments, and edge network — it's how most of my projects go from code to live.

name: AWS
description: Familiar with core AWS services through certification and practice — covering compute, storage, and cloud architecture. Gives me the context to deploy and reason about scalable cloud infrastructure beyond managed platforms.
